# Thongbowl-x-Thongchaplus-x-muzium-Tekstil
Halaman warisan kempen Thong Bowl × Thong Cha Plus Muzium Tekstil Negara meneroka 6 motif tekstil tradisional Malaysia.

<style>

  .logobar img { display: block; object-fit: contain; }
  .logo-tb  { height: 88px; } .logo-mtn { height: 78px; } .logo-tc  { height: 80px; }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */

  /* ---------- Category ---------- */

  /* ---------- Cards ---------- */

  }
  .card-img-wrap img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
  .card-corner {
    position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 10px; width: 26px; height: 26px; z-index: 2;

  .card-overlay {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;
    padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(8,75,50,.92) 0%, rgba(8,75,50,.30) 50%, rgba(8,75,50,0) 78%);

  .card-origin {
    align-self: flex-start; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--green-d); background: var(--gold); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .card-name { font-family:'Fraunces',serif; color:#fff; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }

  .card:hover .card-img-wrap, .card:focus-visible .card-img-wrap { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px rgba(43,38,32,.22); border-color: var(--gold); }
  .card:hover .card-img-wrap img { transform: scale(1.07); }
  .card:hover .card-hint, .card:focus-visible .card-hint { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  .card:focus-visible .card-img-wrap { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }

  /* ---------- Modal ---------- */
  .modal-back { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15,12,7,.6); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; z-index: 50; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .25s; }

    </a>
  </div>

  <footer>Private &amp; Confidential &mdash; Thong Empire Sdn. Bhd. &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; Thong Bowl &times; Muzium Tekstil Negara &times; Thong Cha Plus</footer>
</div>

<div class="modal-back" id="modalBack" onclick="bgClose(event)">
  <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="mTitle">
    <button class="x-btn" onclick="closeModal()" aria-label="Tutup">&times;</button>
    <div class="modal-imgwrap">
      <img class="modal-img" id="mImg" src="" alt="">
      <span class="modal-badge" id="mBadge"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <div class="modal-kicker" id="mKicker">Motif Warisan</div>
      <h3 id="mTitle"></h3>
      <div class="rule"></div>
      <div class="block"><h4>Butiran Motif (Artwork)</h4><p id="mArtwork"></p></div>
      <div class="block"><h4>Kisah di Sebalik Motif (Story)</h4><p id="mStory"></p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  var back = document.getElementById('modalBack');
  function openModal(btn) {
    document.getElementById('mTitle').textContent   = btn.dataset.name;
    document.getElementById('mArtwork').textContent = btn.dataset.artwork;
    document.getElementById('mStory').textContent   = btn.dataset.story;
    document.getElementById('mBadge').textContent   = btn.dataset.origin;
    var img = btn.querySelector('img'), mImg = document.getElementById('mImg');
    mImg.src = img.src; mImg.alt = img.alt;
    document.getElementById('mKicker').textContent = (btn.dataset.cat==='flora') ? 'Motif Flora' : 'Motif Fauna & Alam';
    back.classList.add('show'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  function closeModal() { back.classList.remove('show'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
  function bgClose(e) { if (e.target === back) closeModal(); }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape') closeModal(); });

  // Scroll reveal
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(en){ if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el, i){
    el.style.transitionDelay = (Math.min(i,6)*60) + 'ms';
    io.observe(el);
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>
